messages:
Carlos Mendez: Hi team — on my second day and running into a couple of annoying things: external monitor randomly flickers to black for ~1s, and my Magic Keyboard keeps dropping. Also Wi-Fi seems jerky in calls. Anyone know the right troubleshooting flow?
Jade (IT): Welcome Carlos! Sorry about that. Quick checks: 1) Is the monitor connected via the included USB-C cable or a separate HDMI adapter? 2) When keyboard drops, does macOS show it reconnecting in Bluetooth prefs? 3) Can you run a quick speedtest and paste results? If you prefer, I can hop on a 10m call.
Carlos Mendez: Using the included braided USB-C cable from the box. Keyboard shows "Connected" but then disappears, then reappears. Speedtest: 45 Mbps down / 18 Mbps up, ping 22ms (via Wi-Fi 6 AP).
Jade (IT): Hmm, speeds are fine-ish. The flicker + bluetooth flakiness with a single-cable dock can mean power negotiation or a marginal cable. Can you try: - System Preferences > Bluetooth > click the keyboard > Remove, then re-pair - Hold Option and click Wi-Fi icon > Wireless Diagnostics > run and save results - Also try switching the monitor to 60Hz if its set higher. If you want a quick replacement cable, we can ship one.
Carlos Mendez: Re-paired keyboard once, still saw a drop during a Zoom test. Monitor is at 144Hz currently — I can drop to 60Hz and test.
Jade (IT): Please drop to 60Hz and try. I'm creating a hardware ticket to track shipping a replacement cable and a spare USB-C dock in case.
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket created: HDK-3999 for Carlos Mendez  Peripherals flake (monitor flicker, KB drop, possible cable). Status: Open. Assigned: Jade (IT). Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/HDK-3999
Elliot (Shipping): We have a shorter shielded USB-C cable and an RD-DK-mini dock in stock. I can send both overnight. Carlos, confirm your shipping address?
Carlos Mendez: Confirmed address: 12 Harbor View Ave, Apt 4B. Thanks! Also fyi the flicker happened when I had a big terminal build running. Could be load related.
Nikki (Manager): @Carlos if the replacement doesn't fix it, we can give you a loaner monitor from my team room — no need to wait.
Jade (IT): Good note about load. Could be power/current dips under heavy GPU usage. If the replacement cable/dock don't fix it we'll try the loaner monitor and also collect sys logs. ETA for shipping: tracking link below.
Elliot (Shipping): Shipped via UPS Overnight. Tracking: https://www.ups.com/track?tracknum=1Z888AA10123456785 - expected delivery tomorrow.
Carlos Mendez: Received the cable & mini-dock today. Swapped cable and tested with 60Hz during a compile: no flicker for an hour, keyboard stayed connected. Re-ran a Zoom and the audio/video stayed stable.
Jade (IT): Great! Can you keep an eye on it for 48h? If its stable, I'll close HDK-3999. If it reappears, please grab a short video of the flicker and send sysdiagnose output.
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket HDK-3999 status changed to In Progress by Jade (IT) at 1845007880.
Carlos Mendez: Will do. Thanks @Jade and @Elliot, and @Nikki for the offer. Feels much better now.
Jade (IT): Thanks for confirming — marking ticket resolved after 48h observation if no regressions. :thumbsup:
it-helpdesk-bot: Ticket HDK-3999 status changed to Resolved by Jade (IT) at 1845007904.
